title: calystegia sepium subsp. limnophila
intro: Calystegia sepium subsp. limnophila, commonly known as the sea bindweed or coastal bindweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the morning glory family, Convolvulaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Calystegia sepium subsp. limnophila are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and cardiovascular-protective effects. Additionally, this plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its soothing and calming properties.
